facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A flower opened. A tiny girl was inside. She was so small. She was very small.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: A woman planted a magic seed in a flower pot. A beautiful flower bloomed and a tiny girl was inside. She was very small, even smaller than a thumb. The woman named her Thumbelina and loved her dearly. Thumbelina slept in a walnut shell every night. She was tiny but she had a brave and kind heart.
facts.Word cards: tiny = 아주 작은 / thumb = 엄지손가락 / bloomed = 꽃이 폈다 / appeared = 나타났다
